parsed.strategy: Every holding has a hand-verified dated event inside Oct 12-Nov 13: ASML Oct 14, TSM Oct 15, ARGX Oct 22, Saab/Evolution Oct 23, Teradyne Oct 27, Kongsberg Oct 29, Hon Hai Oct 30, Cameco/Novo Nov 3-4, Rheinmetall/Hensoldt Nov 5, Aristocrat Nov 12, plus two early-window PDUFAs (MRK Oct 10, AGIO Nov 1). Dates are spread across semis, biotech, defense, gambling and nuclear so no single print decides the book. I am wrong if a broad risk-off or AI-capex digestion headline hits the semis sleeve simultaneously, or if the PDUFAs return CRLs (CRLs average -13.7% on the day).
parsed.objective: Maximize relative P&L versus the Bloomberg WLS index from 2026-10-12 to 2026-11-13 by holding only names with dated in-window catalysts.
